description: Hand-authored per-player palm-roll data (racketHand) copied into evidence/forehand-semantics.json by scripts/build-forehand-semantics.mts. Inputs from the video cross-check and the user sweep; the builder no longer reads its own previous output.

videoPalmMeasure.method: MediaPipe pose index/pinky palm normal, forearm-relative roll; 640×360 source

racketHand.note: Pose palm measure rejected or missing; palm roll left at the rig default until a higher-resolution clip or a user-supplied sweep is available.

racketHand.note: Pose palm measure rejected or missing; palm roll left at the rig default until a higher-resolution clip or a user-supplied sweep is available.

racketHand.source: user-specified palm path (≈270° from takeback to contact); pose cross-check only
racketHand.convention: Degrees of forearm pronation/supination (rotation of the palm frame about the racket forearm, elbow→wrist) applied at 引拍 / 落拍 / 前挥. 击球 is the zero anchor, so the contact pose is unchanged. Wrist bend is unchanged by this rotation; the racket head turns about the forearm line.

realised.method: torso-frame palm normal summed over 引拍→落拍→前挥→击球 keys (rig-solved)

videoPalmMeasure.method: MediaPipe pose index/pinky palm normal, forearm-relative roll; 640×360 source

racketHand.note: The 270° target is the user observation. The pose-based palm measure found +24° net and 163° path (low quality), so the magnitude is not confirmed by measurement. The realised path is ≈259°; the remaining ≈11° is held back so the racket head stays above the hand at 引拍 (more forearm roll there would point the head down).
